judgement.reason: This is the Temporal workflow server, a gRPC server that SDK clients and workers connect to, not an HTTP web application, so Deployz cannot serve it behind its HTTP load balancer.

evidence.quote: This repository contains the source code of the Temporal server. To implement Workflows, Activities and Workers, use one of the [supported languages](https://docs.temporal.io/dev-guide/).
The Temporal server executes units of application logic called Workflows in a resilient manner that automatically handles intermittent failures, and retries failed operations.
